description:
Consolidate a duplicate complaint case into a master case record. 

Starting state: Two complaint cases exist regarding the same noise violation issue. The specific Case IDs and instructions are provided in the file '~/Documents/duplicate_processing.txt'.

Your tasks:
1. Open the 'Duplicate Case' listed in the text file and copy its description text.
2. Navigate to the 'Master Case' listed in the text file.
3. Add a new Note to the Master Case containing the description text from the duplicate.
4. Create a relationship/association between the Master Case and the Duplicate Case.
5. Close the Duplicate Case (set status to 'Closed').
